verdict.rationale: Transaction sync creates a permanent record of completed sales, and the docs say calculated rates reflect nexus, product taxability (category/subcategory), exemptions, and the ship-to address. That suggests the inputs to each calculation exist in the system, but nothing shows those per-transaction details are retained alongside the tax or can be exported for an audit. The estimate endpoint explicitly creates no permanent record. Missing for 10: evidence of a per-transaction calculation breakdown (rate, rule/jurisdiction detail, resolved address, applied category) stored with each transaction, an audit export or report, and any independent corroboration.
